theory_ledger.name: Interior matched-evidence impossibility
theory_ledger.implication: For beta > 0 and |M| < beta, evidence-identical target laws can have opposite nonzero benefit.
theory_ledger.evidence: Lean includes measurable target-law and testing constructions under their explicit assumptions; empirical population assumptions are not inferred.

theory_ledger.name: Closed-band abstention
theory_ledger.implication: Under strict-action semantics, abstention is maximal on |M| <= beta.
theory_ledger.evidence: Boundary distinguishes zero-versus-strict ambiguity from the interior construction.

theory_ledger.name: Strict-commitment frontier
theory_ledger.implication: A uniform strict action is supportable exactly outside the declared uncertainty band.
theory_ledger.evidence: Lean covers the feasible measurable target-law class; arbitrary restricted deployment classes are not automatically covered.

theory_ledger.name: Marginal false-adapt certificate
theory_ledger.implication: Interval coverage controls FA_u, not conditional FA_c.
theory_ledger.evidence: Lean derives one-shot residual coverage under exchangeable score laws; this does not verify benchmark exchangeability, population improvement, or repeated-use coverage.

theory_ledger.name: Multiclass bridge
theory_ledger.implication: Delta = P(D)(p_a-p_0); empirical KGA estimates Delta directly.
theory_ledger.evidence: The converse frontier requires declared-class richness.

headline_controlled.name: CIFAR-10-C stress / Tent
headline_controlled.framing: Point estimate is below both fixed policies and ordinary six-family intervals are positive, but p-values from retrospective Holm adjustment over the six prospectively named contrasts are both 0.09375.

headline_controlled.name: CIFAR-10-C stress / EATA

boundary_negative.name: iWildCam H v2

boundary_negative.name: Camelyon17 OOD
boundary_negative.framing: Opened all-helpful OOD diagnostic; KGA ties always-adapt on all 18 conditions.

boundary_negative.name: CIFAR-10.1
boundary_negative.framing: Transfer bar fails; not promoted as a policy win.
boundary_negative.note: Consistent with weak evidence, low margin, estimator inadequacy, or calibration failure.

boundary_negative.name: ImageNet-R Protocol D
boundary_negative.framing: 4 completed run seeds across 10 backbones; an architecture-panel diagnostic, not one deployable policy.
boundary_negative.note: No natural-shift superiority is claimed; a benchmark null does not prove structural non-identifiability.

boundary_negative.name: PACS
boundary_negative.framing: 3-seed aggregate agrees with the archived seed summaries; cell-level decisions remain unreplayable.
boundary_negative.note: archived per-cell files omit b_hat and the calibration-domain residual records; the saved seed summaries can be cross-validated but the gate cannot be rerun

boundary_negative.name: Constructed three-source OOF stream
boundary_negative.framing: Researcher-constructed heterogeneous stream; routing evidence, not unseen-domain transfer.
boundary_negative.note: CI beats both, but the stream is researcher-constructed and does not establish transfer.

metrics.label: FA_u
metrics.meaning: The marginal false-adapt quantity controlled under valid interval coverage.

metrics.label: FA_c
metrics.meaning: Descriptive unless separately proved; not theorem-controlled here.

metrics.label: Abstain
metrics.meaning: Do not commit the update; prediction continues from the frozen fallback.

prose.false_adapt: The empirical certificate is Delta_hat +/- epsilon; epsilon is not beta.
prose.abstain: Empirical abstention may reflect structural ambiguity, finite data, model inadequacy, transfer failure, or conservative width.
prose.unknowable: A benchmark null alone does not establish structural non-identifiability.
prose.certificate_scope: Every claim is limited to its saved protocol, calibration unit, adapter, and artifact lineage.

reproduce.runtime_estimate: Cached audit is CPU-friendly; dataset refreshes require the documented data and accelerator.
